card.name: Linking words in binding and chemistry text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, the, to, from, its, by, not) inside sentences on chemical binding, displacement from proteins, or ionization and acidity. The word sits just before a chemical or binding term.

modes.label: Binding and displacement
modes.description: Linking word right after displace or binding, before serum albumin or proteins.
modes.example: Ceftriaxone can displace bilirubin from its binding<< to>> serum albumin, leading to a risk

modes.label: Chemical groups and ionization
modes.description: Linking word in lists of chemical groups or ionized forms.
modes.example: increase the concentration of<< the>> non-ionized species of the amphetamine
